verdict.rationale: Gusto now spans payroll, banking, and a cash-flow Money Dashboard, so automatically flagging anomalous or out-of-policy transactions is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence only describes business formation, a bank account, and a dashboard view of cash in and out. Nothing shows AI-driven anomaly detection, policy checks, or flagging transactions for review; the dashboard is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.
